hooks.name: New issue kind checklist
hooks.description: Reminds the agent of the diagnoser, explanation, and test requirements whenever issue kinds change.

action.prompt: src/engine/core/types.ts was saved. If an IssueKind was added or changed, confirm per .kiro/steering/repair-strategies.md that it has (1) a diagnoser rule in src/engine/ecosystems/npm/diagnose.ts, (2) an entry in ISSUE_EXPLANATIONS, and (3) a test with a realistic log fixture in tests/. Also update .kiro/specs/repair-engine-upgrade before changing behaviour. Do nothing if no IssueKind changed.
